```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml)
library(glue)

find_data <- function(filename) {
  path <- file.path("_data", filename)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(path)
  path2 <- file.path("..", "_data", filename)
  if (file.exists(path2)) return(path2)
  stop(paste("Cannot find", filename))
}

projects <- yaml::read_yaml(find_data("projects.yml"))

render_tags <- function(tags) {
  if (is.null(tags)) return("")
  spans <- paste0('<span class="dc-tag">', tags, '</span>', collapse = " ")
  paste0('<div class="dc-tags">', spans, '</div>')
}

render_links <- function(links) {
  if (is.null(links)) return("")
  items <- sapply(links, function(l) glue('<a class="dc-proj-link" href="{l$url}" target="_blank">{l$label} &rarr;</a>'))
  paste0('<div class="dc-proj-links">', paste(items, collapse = ""), '</div>')
}

render_project <- function(p, is_past = FALSE) {
  status_html   <- if (!is_past) '<span class="dc-live" style="margin-bottom:0.75rem;display:inline-flex;">Now &middot; Active</span><br>' else ""
  funder_html   <- if (!is.null(p$funder))   glue('<span class="dc-proj-meta">Funder: {p$funder}</span>') else ""
  partners_html <- if (!is.null(p$partners)) glue('<span class="dc-proj-meta">Partners: {paste(p$partners, collapse=" &middot; ")}</span>') else ""
  image_html    <- if (!is.null(p$image))    glue('<div class="dc-proj-image"><img src="{p$image}" alt="{p$title}"></div>') else ""
  past_class    <- if (is_past) " past" else ""
  glue('
<div class="dc-proj-card{past_class}">
  {image_html}
  <div class="dc-proj-body">
    {status_html}
    <div class="dc-proj-year">{p$years}</div>
    <h3 class="dc-proj-title">{p$title}</h3>
    {funder_html}
    {partners_html}
    <p class="dc-proj-desc">{p$description}</p>
    {render_tags(p$tags)}
    {render_links(p$links)}
  </div>
</div>')
}
```

<p class="dc-research-intro">
My research moves between urbanism, landscape architecture, and spatial data science — always with an eye on what the data can actually tell us about how cities work, fail, and adapt. I use GIS, QGIS, and R to analyze, model, and assess how cities respond to climate pressures and how interventions perform on the ground.
</p>

for (p in projects$current) cat(render_project(p, is_past = FALSE), "\n")

cat('<div class="dc-section-divider" style="margin-top:4rem;"><span class="dc-section-divider-label">02 — Past Research</span><div class="dc-section-divider-line"></div></div>')
for (p in projects$past) cat(render_project(p, is_past = TRUE), "\n")
